meta.title: Preservation of language, script and culture.

versions.author: Zulfikar Ali Bhutto
versions.subject: Original Constitution 1973-08-14 Zulfikar Ali Bhutto
versions.content:
| Title        | Preservation of language, script and culture.                                               |
| ------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| First Added  | 14 August 1973                                                                              |
| Last Updated | 14 August 1973                                                                              |
| Source       | https://factfocus.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/03/Original-Constitution-of-1973-Pakistan.pdf |

Subject to Article 251 any section of citizens having a distinct language, script or culture shall have the right to preserve and promote the same and subject to law, establish institutions for that purpose.
